authorization: Operator approved separate hypothetical-extension review only. No physical identification follows from this approval.

predecessor.disposition: Preserved byte for byte; no retroactive physical admission.

source_realized: Raman atom-light coupling produces optical Peierls phases and laboratory propagation within its approximation regime. This belongs to the source apparatus only.

proposed_identification.target: A physical map from original PAH coordinates into source matter/field degrees of freedom, with probe dependence on actual U and the original stochastic path law at independently calibrated laboratory time.
proposed_identification.not_a_definition: Do not set exp(-i phi_e)=U_e by fiat, replace Markov time by hbar/K, or program controls from PAH samples and call it a natural coupling.

conditional_interface.Hamiltonian: If a physical interaction independently yields H_X(tau)=-sum_(e=(v,w)) [J_e(tau) U_e(X_(t_r(tau)))|w><v|+conj(J_e(tau) U_e(X_(t_r(tau))))|v><w|], one has a gauge-compatible probe candidate. Complex J_e are allowed with the ENTIRE coefficient conjugated in the reverse term; assume bounded integrable pulse controls on the finite interval and hbar>0. This IF is the missing physics, not an adopted term.
conditional_interface.gauge: For time-independent g_v phases, U_e -> g_w U_e conjugate(g_v); H[g.U]=D_g H[U]D_g^dagger with fixed J_e. Time-dependent transformations need an additional connection term and are not used. Gauge covariance is a necessary consistency test, not sufficient physical justification.
conditional_interface.readout: OBS001's calibrated reference-arm response remains conditional. Nonzero link hopping alone does not implement its closed-path pulses or simultaneous equal-face W estimator.
conditional_interface.clock: For the synchronized dynamic claim, realize the original state-process generator q(x,y)=sum_(valid r:rx=y)c_r(x) in the physical BACKGROUND marginal, preserving every original root contribution/multiplicity and not just detailed-balance ratios. Distinct physical labels for duplicate roots are not required for W(X_t). The quantum probe need not itself be a CTMC. Independently justified drives or open-system mechanisms are allowed; no specific reservoir is presumed. A state/process map and a justified t_r are needed; no scalar time factor selected. Purely static sensitivity has a distinct, weaker obligation.
conditional_interface.causal_discriminator: Keep apparatus settings fixed and independently vary a physically identified gauge-invariant background quantity with different U_p. Require an exclusion/control argument for any direct intervention effect on detectors, fields, controls, preparation or shared noise, with independent calibration and sham controls. A gauge relabelling is not this intervention, and U inferred from the same Y is not an independent witness. No such physical intervention is supplied: this is a design criterion, not an executable PAH experiment.

conditional_error.scope: Finite-dimensional single-probe projected lattice, fixed pulse schedule and unique undirected edges without self-loops; illustrative bound only, not the original PAH dynamics or physical apparatus in all bands.
conditional_error.definition: eta_link=(1/hbar) integral sum_e |J_e(tau)| |U_e(X_(t_r(tau)))-U_e(X_(t0))| d tau. Each Hermitian edge difference has norm |J_e| |delta U_e|.
conditional_error.derivation: Duhamel's identity between the time-ordered propagators with moving and frozen links gives ||V_X-V_0||<=eta_link. For any density state and bounded observable O, the expectation difference is <=2||O|| eta_link. Both propagators use the same pulse schedule, so this does not replace it by an average.
conditional_error.other_errors: An additional known Hamiltonian residual R gives eta_R=(1/hbar) integral ||R||d tau and the same expectation bound after state-space identification. Band leakage requires a justified embedding/leakage bound; Markov marginal disturbance and clock errors are separate and not covered by this norm alone.
conditional_error.not_guaranteed: No actual J_e-U realization, t_r, residual norm, disturbance, covariance or usable numerical error envelope is supplied. A formula with unknown terms is not a guaranteed error bound.

acceptance: Only an independently justified physical realization filling these fields can be admitted for the dynamic test; proposed equations alone cannot. Independently controlled drives are allowed, but PAH sample playback is not physical identification.
falsifiers: Response depends only on externally programmed laser phases rather than the actual background.
Only Gibbs ratios agree while the physical rates or absolute scale do not.
The readout measures a contrast-weighted or energy-weighted sum instead of equal-face W.
The source approximation, leakage or disturbance error cannot meet the frozen accuracy target.
Time/rates are selected after viewing W dynamics or holdout data.
non_claims: No new physical model adoption, actual measurement, Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, GR, continuum, mass gap or TOE.
The comparator failure is not a global impossibility theorem. No automatic successor.
